longTitle: An Act to give the expiry of the Bangladesh (Restoration of Evacuee Property) Order, 1972, the effect of repeal of an Act.
preamble: WHEREAS it is expedient to give the expiry of the Bangladesh (Restoration of Evacuee Property) Order, 1972 (P.O. No. 13 of 1972), the effect of repeal of an Act; It is hereby enacted as follows:—

body.text: This Act may be called the Bangladesh (Restoration of Evacuee Property) (Effect of Expiry) Act, 1975.
It shall be deemed to have come into force on the 25th day of March, 1975.

sections.title: Effect of Expiry, P.O. No. 13 of 1972

body.text: It is hereby declared that the expiry of the Bangladesh (Restoration of Evacuee Property) Order, 1972 (P.O. No. 13 of 1972), on the 25th day of March, 1975 shall have the effect of repeal of an Act as provided in section 6 of the General Clauses Act, 1897 (X of 1897).
The Bangladesh (Restoration of Evacuee Property) (Effect of Expiry) Ordinance, 1975 (XVI of 1975) is hereby repealed. <div class="
